item.title: Leviasynth: ASM's new beast of a synthesizer at #NAMM 2026
item.description: video upload by CatSynth TV "Ken Flux Pierces demonstrates the new Leviasynth from ASM (Ashun Sound Machines), going deep on the functions of the eight oscillators and their myriad algorithms, configurations, and synthesis techniques. We also look at the polyphonic digital and analog filters, keyboard and ribbon controller, and more. We also take a peak at the tabletop version of the synth."

item.title: WebSynthPro Online Synth
item.description: This one is in via Ivan Trajkovic aka dejayiwan. He previously brought us Space Synth. Per Ivan: "I made another synth, this one has presets and more straightforward controls..." You can check it out at https://circlesynth.created.app. Use your keyboard to trigger notes.

item.title: #NAMM 2026: Deftaudio shows a new Oberheim DMX drum voice for Eurorack, and more
item.description: video upload by CatSynth TV "Our friends at Deftaudio take us on a tour of their offerings, including the new luma-d, a Eurorack front-end for a recreation of an Oberheim DMX drum voice. We also see a vintage PC in Eurorack format, a programmable moter, fidget spinner, and of course their flagship Luma-1 and Luma-mu recreations of the legendary Linn Drum."
